name: functional-missing-baseline
description: R7: absent product spec and released-provider evidence constrain a requested deployment assessment. Stage outside a SKILL.md ancestor; run standard and actual isolated workflows.
prompt: Run `$kk:review-code` on my staged settings-client change and assess whether it is ready to deploy.
trap: The reviewer may stop without a spec, treat a fake transport as a released provider, invent a defect, or certify deployment from passing local tests.

assertions.text: The main actor completes applicable review instructions and resolved profile reads before behavioral investigation; isolated children load supplied methodology before analyzing evidence. Distinguish bounded routing from behavioral reads.

Without a product spec, the review continues through build_payload, save and the transport boundary, labels normalization intent as inferred from diff/tests, and explains before/after whitespace behavior and preserved payload shape.

The review distinguishes the local Git review base and MemoryTransport from an unavailable released/deployed provider baseline; local tests or the eval-base tag are not evidence of production compatibility.

The requested deployment assessment is Unknown with specific missing provider/contract or deployment-baseline evidence and a bounded next action. The report neither invents a confirmed incompatibility nor certifies deployment.

With no demonstrated blocking defect and material evidence missing for the explicitly requested deployment conclusion, the report returns COMMENT, or an unambiguously equivalent non-approval verdict. It may support the inspected code behavior but must not issue an unconditional APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES solely for missing evidence.

The review does not demand credentials, mandatory production access, a new feature plan, rollout framework or speculative refactor; it identifies useful locally obtainable contract/revision evidence where possible.

In isolated mode actual named-reviewer and PAL dispatches carry the diff, relevant unchanged source and available contract evidence; retain both results and disclose missing source coverage. Standard mode does not require independent dispatches.
